instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Real estate brokerage with 8 offices and 85 agents facilitating residential and light commercial transactions. Average of 600 closed transactions annually. Evaluating AI-powered property valuation models and automated comparable market analysis report generation. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers. Decision-making is fast and informal, but we lack the specialized expertise in-house to evaluate complex technology investments without external advisory support.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 4 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 10% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Develop and Institutionalize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
opportunities.rationale: The company has demonstrated a critical vulnerability due to the loss of institutional knowledge (abandoned dashboard). Formalizing core processes will stabilize operations, mitigate key-person risk, and provide the foundational data structure necessary for future digital investments.

first_actions: Map 3 high-volume, repeatable transactions (e.g., CMA creation, lead qualification) to identify current process gaps.
Establish a 'Knowledge Capture' workshop involving operations staff and the founder to document workflows.
Draft initial SOP drafts with mandatory compliance checkpoints integrated into each step.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of 3 core SOP manuals adopted by the operations team within 90 days.
milestones: Workflow mapping completed for high-volume process X.
Management review and approval of draft SOPs.
Training conducted on compliance adherence using new SOPs.

opportunities.title: Pilot Automated Valuation Model (AVM) for CMA Enhancement
opportunities.rationale: To meet the strategic goal of improving EBITDA and leveraging technology, a controlled Proof-of-Concept (PoC) on AI/ML valuation is necessary. By limiting scope to AVM enhancement, we manage risk while capturing measurable efficiency gains in reporting.

first_actions: Assemble historical, anonymized transaction data sets for initial model training.
Engage a specialized external consultancy (AI/ML firm) to define the PoC scope and success parameters.
Define clear user acceptance criteria (UAC) for the output of the AVM system.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Deployment of a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) that generates valuation estimates with <10% deviation from human-calculated benchmark on 50 test properties.
milestones: Consultancy scoping meeting and proposal acceptance.
Initial PoC model testing and findings presentation.

next_steps.action: Establish a formal Process Improvement Working Group (PIWG) to drive the SOP development, ensuring representation from operations and compliance.
Finalize the scope document for the AVM PoC, including specific data inputs required and measurable success benchmarks (ROI).
Mandate cross-functional training on updated data governance protocols to ensure compliance is built into all new processes (High Regulation response).

key_weaknesses: Founder dependency: The founder remains the single point of decision-making for technology and product strategy.
Process documentation deficit: Core business knowledge is still embedded in individuals rather than formalized processes.
Structural inertia: Despite new leadership mandate, deep cultural resistance to adopting structured process change persists.

improvements: Improved strategic clarity and executive buy-in (new CEO's focus on digital transformation).
Demonstrable revenue growth (10% YoY) validates market positioning.
Engagement in technology exploration (AI/ML PoC discussions) shows increased capability.
persistent_gaps: Transitioning from informal, ad-hoc projects to institutionally backed processes remains challenging.
Lack of formal technical expertise means technological adoption requires costly external advisory support.
Siloed decision-making (owner alone) limits the scalability and pace of change.
achieved_milestones: Strategic partnerships are formalized, expanding market reach and stability.
Core elements of existing recommendations (Opp 3) have been successfully closed out.
Increased executive focus has elevated digital transformation from a suggestion to a top-tier mandate.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The organization has transitioned from a purely reactive/informal state to one with clear executive mandate and measurable operational improvements (revenue growth, partnerships). The focus has shifted towards building structured processes necessary for scalable efficiency gains, acknowledging the necessity of managing high regulatory risk through formal systems.
